description: Unofficial portable Windows build of DeepSeek Harness Desktop, an Electron AI coding workspace.
notes: Unofficial, unsigned community build, not an official DeepSeek distribution. Based on upstream 0.2.1-rc.3, including prerelease code.
Uses a bundled Node/Python runtime. No separate dsh CLI installation is required or registered by this manifest.
The reviewed community patch omits mandatory update-policy metadata for unsigned builds. No official updater feed is configured. Use Scoop for updates.
User data stays in upstream default locations. No existing configuration is migrated or removed. Do not run concurrently with an official installation sharing that data.
Build-time runtime/ASAR/ConPTY/Host checks and isolated Windows process startup passed. Account sign-in, model sessions and full GUI interaction were not tested.
Unsigned binaries may trigger SmartScreen. Review the release notes, build-source.json and retained licenses before installation.
